newsitem.title: MEXICO: Ceramic says rights issue in coming months.
newsitem.headline: Ceramic says rights issue in coming months.

text.p: Internacional de Ceramica S.A. de C.V. (Ceramic) plans a rights issue in the coming months, a company spokesman told Reuters on Monday.

"The company's strategy is to undertake (the issue) at the end of the first quarter (of 1997), or at the beginning of the second quarter," said a spokesman for the company's vice-president of finance and administration

"It would be a rights issue, the idea is that shareholders subscribe to the issue," the spokesman added, noting that a Ceramic shareholders meeting in 1996 had authorized the issue of up to 10 million units.

Ceramic lists UB and ULD units on the Mexican Stock Exchange. Each UB unit consists of two B series shares, while each ULD units consists of one L series and one D series share. Each Ceramic ADR consists of five ULD units.
Funds derived from the offer will be used to decrease the company's debt, the spokesman said.
"We are aware the company is in debt, but we have never stopped paying. Ideally, we would have leverage of unity or a little less," he added.

Ceramic closed 1995 with a debt-to-equity ratio and an interest-bearing-debt-to-equity ratio of 2.3 and 1.99, respectively. Ceramic total debt at the close of 1996 was nearly 1.139 billion pesos, the company said.
Ceramic reported its fourth quarter and whole year earnings last week. The company posted a per-unit loss of 16 centavos for the quarter, but whole year earnings of 2.30 pesos per shareholding unit.
